    <style>
        * {
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        /* ===== KHÔNG SCROLL: khóa đúng bằng chiều cao màn hình ===== */

        body {

        }

        .game-container {
            width: min(650px, 100%);
            max-height: 100%;
            background: #202c40;
            border: 1px solid #35455d;
            border-radius: 16px;
            padding: clamp(10px, 2.2dvh, 25px) clamp(12px, 3vw, 25px);
            box-shadow: 0 15px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
            text-align: center;
        }

        h1 {
            margin: 0 0 4px;
            font-size: clamp(24px, 4.5dvh, 34px);
        }

        .subtitle {
            color: #aeb8c7;
            margin-bottom: clamp(8px, 2dvh, 22px);
            font-size: clamp(12px, 2dvh, 16px);
        }

        .top-panel {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 8px;
            flex-wrap: nowrap;
            margin-bottom: clamp(8px, 1.8dvh, 20px);
        }

        .info-box {
            min-width: 0;
            flex: 1 1 0;
            max-width: 150px;
            background: #2b3850;
            border: 1px solid #40506a;
            border-radius: 9px;
            padding: clamp(6px, 1.2dvh, 10px) 8px;
            font-weight: bold;
            font-size: clamp(12px, 1.9dvh, 15px);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .timer-container {
            width: 100%;
            height: 10px;
            background: #303d52;
            border-radius: 20px;
            overflow: hidden;
            margin-bottom: clamp(10px, 2.2dvh, 25px);
        }

        .timer-bar {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: #f5a000;
            transition: width 0.05s linear;
        }

        .question-box {
            background: #29364b;
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: clamp(10px, 2.2dvh, 25px) 10px;
            margin-bottom: clamp(10px, 2.2dvh, 22px);
        }

        .instruction {
            color: #aeb8c7;
            font-size: clamp(12px, 1.8dvh, 14px);
            margin-bottom: clamp(4px, 1.2dvh, 15px);
        }

        .color-word {
            font-size: clamp(34px, min(10vw, 8dvh), 72px);
            font-weight: 900;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            min-height: clamp(44px, 9dvh, 90px);
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            user-select: none;
            text-align: center;
            line-height: 1.1;
        }

        /* ===== ĐÁP ÁN: số cột do JS set (--cols), số nút do JS quyết định ===== */
        .answers {
            --cols: 4;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(var(--cols), 1fr);
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .color-button {
            width: 100%;
            height: clamp(38px, 7.5dvh, 64px);
            min-height: 0;
            padding: 0;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 9px;
            cursor: pointer;
            position: relative;
            transition: transform 0.12s, filter 0.12s;
            box-shadow:
                inset 0 0 0 3px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15),
                0 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
        }

        .color-button:hover {
            filter: brightness(1.1);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        .color-button:active {
            transform: scale(0.95);
        }

        .color-button:disabled {
            cursor: default;
        }

        .feedback {
            min-height: clamp(20px, 3.5dvh, 30px);
            margin-top: clamp(6px, 1.5dvh, 18px);
            font-size: clamp(15px, 2.4dvh, 19px);
            font-weight: bold;
        }

        .correct-feedback {
            color: #66d99a;
        }

        .wrong-feedback {
            color: #ff7373;
        }

        .controls {
            margin-top: clamp(6px, 1.5dvh, 20px);
        }

        .main-button {
            border: none;
            border-radius: 9px;
            padding: clamp(8px, 1.6dvh, 12px) 25px;
            background: #f5a000;
            color: #172235;
            font-size: 16px;
            font-weight: bold;
            cursor: pointer;
        }

        .main-button:hover {
            filter: brightness(1.08);
        }

        .game-message {

        }

        }

        }

<body style="visibility: hidden;">

    <div class="game-container">

        <h1>🎨 Color Match</h1>

        <div class="subtitle">Match the color, not the word!</div>

        <div class="top-panel">
            <div class="info-box">⭐ Score: <span id="score">0</span></div>
            <div class="info-box">🏆 Best: <span id="bestScore">0</span></div>
            <div class="info-box">🎯 Round: <span id="round">1</span></div>
        </div>

        <div class="timer-container">
            <div class="timer-bar" id="timerBar"></div>
        </div>

        <div class="question-box">
            <div class="instruction">Chọn màu mà chữ đang được hiển thị</div>
            <div class="color-word" id="colorWord">RED</div>
        </div>

        <div class="answers" id="answers"></div>

        <div class="feedback" id="feedback"></div>

        <div class="level-info">Tốc độ sẽ tăng dần khi bạn trả lời đúng.</div>

        <div class="controls">
            <button type="button" class="main-button" id="restartButton">🔄 Restart</button>
        </div>

    </div>

    <div class="game-message" id="gameMessage">
        <div class="message-box">
            <h2 id="messageTitle">🎨 Color Match</h2>
            <p id="messageText">
                Hãy chọn đúng màu của chữ.
                <br>
                Đừng chọn theo nội dung chữ!
            </p>
            <button type="button" class="main-button" id="startButton">▶ Start Game</button>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        /*
         * 32 màu (pool). Mỗi round chỉ hiển thị một phần trong số này.
         */
        const COLOR_MATCH_COLORS = [
            { key: "red", name: "RED", value: "#ef4444" },
            { key: "blue", name: "BLUE", value: "#2196f3" },
            { key: "green", name: "GREEN", value: "#4caf50" },
            { key: "yellow", name: "YELLOW", value: "#fbc02d" },
            { key: "purple", name: "PURPLE", value: "#9c27b0" },
            { key: "orange", name: "ORANGE", value: "#ff9800" },
            { key: "pink", name: "PINK", value: "#e91e63" },
            { key: "brown", name: "BROWN", value: "#795548" },
            { key: "black", name: "BLACK", value: "#212121" },
            { key: "white", name: "WHITE", value: "#f5f5f5" },
            { key: "cyan", name: "CYAN", value: "#00bcd4" },
            { key: "lime", name: "LIME", value: "#8bc34a" },
            { key: "teal", name: "TEAL", value: "#009688" },
            { key: "indigo", name: "INDIGO", value: "#3f51b5" },
            { key: "deep-orange", name: "DEEP ORANGE", value: "#ff5722" },
            { key: "deep-purple", name: "DEEP PURPLE", value: "#673ab7" },
            { key: "light-blue", name: "LIGHT BLUE", value: "#03a9f4" },
            { key: "light-green", name: "LIGHT GREEN", value: "#66bb6a" },
            { key: "amber", name: "AMBER", value: "#ffc107" },
            { key: "deep-pink", name: "DEEP PINK", value: "#c2185b" },
            { key: "magenta", name: "MAGENTA", value: "#d000d0" },
            { key: "violet", name: "VIOLET", value: "#7c3aed" },
            { key: "navy", name: "NAVY", value: "#1e3a8a" },
            { key: "sky-blue", name: "SKY BLUE", value: "#38bdf8" },
            { key: "olive", name: "OLIVE", value: "#808000" },
            { key: "maroon", name: "MAROON", value: "#800000" },
            { key: "gold", name: "GOLD", value: "#d4af37" },
            { key: "silver", name: "SILVER", value: "#9ca3af" },
            { key: "coral", name: "CORAL", value: "#ff7f50" },
            { key: "turquoise", name: "TURQUOISE", value: "#14b8a6" },
            { key: "salmon", name: "SALMON", value: "#fa8072" },
            { key: "crimson", name: "CRIMSON", value: "#dc143c" }
        ];

        /*
         * ===== CẤU HÌNH SỐ ĐÁP ÁN =====
         * SP (điện thoại): 8 nút  = 4 cột x 2 hàng
         * PC (màn hình lớn): 12 nút = 6 cột x 2 hàng
         * Muốn chỉnh thì sửa 4 số này.
         */
        const ANSWER_COUNT_MOBILE = 8;
        const COLUMNS_MOBILE = 4;
        const ANSWER_COUNT_DESKTOP = 12;
        const COLUMNS_DESKTOP = 6;

        const desktopQuery = window.matchMedia(
            "(min-width: 768px) and (min-height: 560px)"
        );

        const colorWord = document.getElementById("colorWord");
        const answers = document.getElementById("answers");
        const scoreElement = document.getElementById("score");
        const bestScoreElement = document.getElementById("bestScore");
        const roundElement = document.getElementById("round");
        const timerBar = document.getElementById("timerBar");
        const feedback = document.getElementById("feedback");
        const gameMessage = document.getElementById("gameMessage");
        const messageTitle = document.getElementById("messageTitle");
        const messageText = document.getElementById("messageText");
        const startButton = document.getElementById("startButton");
        const restartButton = document.getElementById("restartButton");

        let score = 0;
        let round = 1;
        let bestScore = Number(localStorage.getItem("colorMatchBestScore")) || 0;
        let currentAnswer = "";
        let gameRunning = false;
        let roundLocked = false;
        let timer = null;
        let roundStartTime = 0;
        let currentTimeLimit = 5000;

        const MIN_TIME_LIMIT = 1000;
        const TIME_DECREASE = 120;

        bestScoreElement.textContent = bestScore;

        function randomItem(array) {
            return array[Math.floor(Math.random() * array.length)];
        }

        function shuffle(array) {
            const copy = array.slice();
            for (let i = copy.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
                const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
                [copy[i], copy[j]] = [copy[j], copy[i]];
            }
            return copy;
        }

        /*
         * ===== TẠO NÚT ĐÁP ÁN CHO MỖI ROUND =====
         *
         * Gồm:
         * 1. Đáp án đúng (màu thật của chữ)
         * 2. Màu mà chữ đang "viết" (cái bẫy) - nếu khác đáp án đúng
         * 3. Các màu ngẫu nhiên khác cho đủ số lượng
         *
         * Sau đó xáo trộn vị trí.
         */
        function renderAnswers(actualColor, displayedWord) {

            const isDesktop = desktopQuery.matches;
            const count = isDesktop ? ANSWER_COUNT_DESKTOP : ANSWER_COUNT_MOBILE;
            const columns = isDesktop ? COLUMNS_DESKTOP : COLUMNS_MOBILE;

            const chosen = [actualColor];

            if (displayedWord.key !== actualColor.key) {
                chosen.push(displayedWord);
            }

            const others = shuffle(
                COLOR_MATCH_COLORS.filter(function (item) {
                    return !chosen.some(function (c) {
                        return c.key === item.key;
                    });
                })
            );

            while (chosen.length < count && others.length > 0) {
                chosen.push(others.pop());
            }

            answers.style.setProperty("--cols", columns);
            answers.innerHTML = "";

            shuffle(chosen).forEach(function (color) {

                const button = document.createElement("button");

                button.type = "button";
                button.className = "color-button";
                button.dataset.color = color.key;
                button.style.backgroundColor = color.value;
                button.setAttribute("aria-label", color.name);

                button.addEventListener("click", function () {
                    selectColor(color.key);
                });

                answers.appendChild(button);
            });
        }

        function startGame() {
            clearTimer();

            score = 0;
            round = 1;
            currentTimeLimit = 4000;
            gameRunning = true;
            roundLocked = false;

            scoreElement.textContent = score;
            roundElement.textContent = round;
            feedback.textContent = "";
            feedback.className = "feedback";

            gameMessage.classList.add("hidden");

            nextRound();
        }

        function nextRound() {

            if (!gameRunning) {
                return;
            }

            roundLocked = false;

            feedback.textContent = "";
            feedback.className = "feedback";

            const actualColor = randomItem(COLOR_MATCH_COLORS);

            let displayedWord = randomItem(COLOR_MATCH_COLORS);

            /* 80% chữ và màu khác nhau */
            if (Math.random() < 0.8) {
                displayedWord = randomItem(
                    COLOR_MATCH_COLORS.filter(function (item) {
                        return item.key !== actualColor.key;
                    })
                );
            }

            currentAnswer = actualColor.key;

            colorWord.textContent = displayedWord.name;
            colorWord.style.color = actualColor.value;

            roundElement.textContent = round;

            renderAnswers(actualColor, displayedWord);

            startTimer();
        }

        function getColorValue(key) {
            const color = COLOR_MATCH_COLORS.find(function (item) {
                return item.key === key;
            });
            return color ? color.value : "#ffffff";
        }

        function startTimer() {
            clearTimer();
            roundStartTime = performance.now();
            timerBar.style.width = "100%";
            timer = requestAnimationFrame(updateTimer);
        }

        function updateTimer(timestamp) {

            if (!gameRunning || roundLocked) {
                return;
            }

            const elapsed = timestamp - roundStartTime;
            const remaining = Math.max(0, currentTimeLimit - elapsed);

            timerBar.style.width = (remaining / currentTimeLimit) * 100 + "%";

            if (remaining <= 0) {
                timeUp();
                return;
            }

            timer = requestAnimationFrame(updateTimer);
        }

        function clearTimer() {
            if (timer !== null) {
                cancelAnimationFrame(timer);
                timer = null;
            }
        }

        function selectColor(color) {

            if (!gameRunning || roundLocked) {
                return;
            }

            roundLocked = true;
            clearTimer();

            if (color === currentAnswer) {
                handleCorrect();
            } else {
                handleWrong();
            }
        }

        function handleCorrect() {

            score += calculateScore();
            scoreElement.textContent = score;

            feedback.textContent = "✓ Correct!";
            feedback.className = "feedback correct-feedback";

            currentTimeLimit = Math.max(
                MIN_TIME_LIMIT,
                currentTimeLimit - TIME_DECREASE
            );

            round++;

            setTimeout(nextRound, 220);
        }

        function calculateScore() {
            return 10 + Math.min(round, 20);
        }

        function handleWrong() {
            feedback.textContent = "✗ Wrong!";
            feedback.className = "feedback wrong-feedback";
            setTimeout(endGame, 350);
        }

        function timeUp() {

            if (roundLocked) {
                return;
            }

            roundLocked = true;
            clearTimer();

            feedback.textContent = "⏰ Time's up!";
            feedback.className = "feedback wrong-feedback";

            setTimeout(endGame, 350);
        }

        function endGame() {

            clearTimer();

            gameRunning = false;
            roundLocked = true;

            if (score > bestScore) {
                bestScore = score;
                localStorage.setItem("colorMatchBestScore", bestScore);
            }

            bestScoreElement.textContent = bestScore;

            messageTitle.textContent = "💥 Game Over";

            messageText.innerHTML = `
                Score: <strong>${score}</strong>
                <br>
                Best: <strong>${bestScore}</strong>
                <br>
                Reached round: <strong>${round}</strong>
            `;

            startButton.textContent = "🔄 Play Again";

            gameMessage.classList.remove("hidden");
        }

        startButton.addEventListener("click", startGame);
        restartButton.addEventListener("click", startGame);

        /*
         * Màn hình chờ ban đầu: hiển thị sẵn một bộ nút
         * để layout không bị trống phía sau popup.
         */
        (function initPreview() {
            const a = COLOR_MATCH_COLORS[0];
            const b = COLOR_MATCH_COLORS[1];
            renderAnswers(a, b);
        })();

        /*
         * ============================================================
         * MYWEBPLAY HTML PLAY
         * ============================================================
         */
        setInterval(
            function () {

                document
                    .querySelectorAll(
                        "div[style*='opacity: 0.9'][style*='z-index: 2147483647']"
                    )
                    .forEach((el) => el.remove());

                document
                    .querySelectorAll("div[onmouseover='S_ssac();']")
                    .forEach((el) => el.remove());

                document
                    .querySelectorAll("center")
                    .forEach((el) => el.remove());

                document
                    .querySelectorAll("div[style='height: 65px;']")
                    .forEach((el) => el.remove());

            },
            10
        );
    </script>
</body>
</html>
